entries.title: The compound is woven from living branches among four sturdy oaks
entries.text: The compound is woven from living branches among four sturdy oaks. A flowered, bowl-shaped garden platform is raised above the ground; beyond it, the enclosed central platform has a door on the side nearest the garden and evenly spaced window-sized gaps. The smaller bedroom platform stands higher still. The platforms connect by root-and-branch slopes; two small huts and a large outhouse sit below.

A flowered, bowl-shaped garden sits above the ground, and an enclosed wooden-and-branch structure rises beyond it. Three great apes lounge or play with oversized dice on the lawn beside iron greatswords. Below the platforms stand two small huts and a large outhouse.

entries.title: Howling, angry shouts, and an occasional scream draw nearer
entries.text: Howling, angry shouts, and an occasional scream draw nearer. A hulking half-orc pushes through the crowd with one hand on a greatsword. Three large wolves wear iron collars; behind him, a huge cloaked figure's heavy footfalls rise above the commotion. The half-orc fixes his small eyes on the sheep and says, “That sheep is Master Noke’s... he desires to have it back.”

entries.text: The sheep's bleating changes into cultured Common with an elven accent and a slight bleat.
